whatThisIs: Paired live measurement of the marketplace catalog on both apps, through each app's own bridge. Replaces the earlier loose claim of '3 catalog differences waiting on upstream' with a named 11-entry delta and a stated cause.
how: Both probes call `window.desktop.mcp.catalog()` — the same bridge entry the UI uses — and are identity-guarded by the asar href each returned.
Official: `npm`-independent probe over CDP 9224. Local: the deployed `/Applications/Grok Node.app` over CDP 9232.

cause.summary: The local build's catalog is a STRICT SUBSET of official's: 11 entries missing, 0 invented. All 11 are account-connected connectors.
cause.mechanism: `fetchMarketplaceMcpPlugins` calls `listMarketplacePlugins({ excludeCloudAgentPlugins: true })` once — there is no pagination, so this is not a page-boundary bug. It then merges private and team marketplaces only when `includesPrivateMarketplaces` is true, and that flag is `(await bestEffortToken(getAccessToken)) != null`. Official is signed in; this build deliberately is not, so the private/team marketplaces are never merged.
cause.why_not_fixable_here: The fix would be to hold a Cursor account token. This repository refuses to fabricate or bypass one, so the gap stays open by policy, not by oversight.

theEleven.note: Google Docs / Google Sheets / Google Slides / OneDrive / Outlook / Outlook Calendar / SharePoint / Teams / Finance / X Money are the account-connected family; oh-my-claudecode is the odd one out.

correction.whatWasSaidBefore: The 为你推荐 (Featured) row was described as differing by one entry because the local build cannot obtain team-popularity data, official being signed in.
correction.whatTheMeasurementSays: `window.desktop.mcp.teamPopularity()` returns an EMPTY OBJECT ON BOTH APPS — official included, and official is the one that is signed in. So missing popularity data does not explain the row, and the earlier attribution was wrong.
correction.whatRemainsUnknown: What actually drives the 为你推荐 ordering. This measurement does not answer it, so it stays an open item rather than a settled conclusion.

corroborating.bridgeSurfaceDiff: Official's bridge additionally exposes financeOverview / deleteFinanceConnection / startFinanceLink / refreshCatalog / grokBotAgentServers / reconcileUnpublishedPlugin. Those are the account-gated surface, which is the same boundary the 11 entries sit behind.

cannotProve: That oh-my-claudecode is behind the same account gate as the other ten. It is grouped as 'the odd one out' because the name does not match the connector family; its membership in a private marketplace was not verified separately.

The cause is inferred from the code path plus the identity of the 11 entries, not by toggling the token and re-measuring. A signed-in local run would confirm it directly, and that run is exactly what the compliance boundary forbids.
Anything about rendering. This is a data-plane measurement only.
